```{r}
library(ramp.trace)
```


```{r}
tv = c(-1:6)*365/4
yv = c(1/2, 1, 2, 1, 1/3, 1, 3, 1) 
sp0 <- makepar_F_spline(tv, yv)
```


```{r}
ff <- make_function(sp0)
```


```{r}
tt = seq(0,550)
plot(tt, ff(tt), type = "l")
```
